name: South shore strip
summary: A second island runway on the flat coastal band south of the mountain ring, laid east-west along the shore so each end's circuit lies out over the sea.

sources.place: Where the island's rock map (400 m a character, 2026-09-19, lane/pattern) shows flat slab from z 4,800 to the island's edge at 7,200 for x past 3,200: the only flat ground on the island wide enough for a runway and a circuit. Every interior site of that size has rock in it.
sources.pattern: Right-hand traffic is published per runway end where terrain or noise calls for it (AIM 4-3-3 b, AC 90-66C 11.1). Here each end's pattern side is the SEA side: landing west from the threshold the sea is to the left, landing east from the far end it is to the right.
